lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with the highest-intensity centroids located in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating visible anchor nodes across the mid-flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-to-moderate distribution of small, high-luminance blobs across the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with higher density observed near the base and posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of five commensal fish (likely remoras) is visible in the ventral region, positioned posterior to the insertion of the right pectoral fin.
